description: Pain-elemental skull spawning, attack and death; full actor dispatcher and playable game remain unfinished.

decisions.reference: Original A_PainShootSkull, A_PainAttack, A_PainDie, FaceTarget and Fall compiled as host C, with controlled placement/damage/charge boundaries; all 66 fields and ordered events match.
scope: Population thresholds 0/19/20/21/22, dying skulls and excluded retired actors
All three spawn orders, angular wrap and radius-based placement
Placement success masks, damage arguments and target-copy order
Missing targets and every shadow RNG start
Actual native placement, blocked-height and actor-overlap deaths
Dying and inactive skull count behavior with the 21st-skull boundary
Ordered three-spawn death, targetless and stale-generation behavior
Shadow charge RNG and first-sound failure ownership

remaining: Native host input/render pacing and UI/audio
